description: This file provides a generic hash map implementation in C, including data structures, function prototypes, macros, and inline functions for managing hash tables, entries, and string interning. It includes example usage and hash functions for strings and memory.

methods.name: hashmap_entry_init
methods.description: Initializes a hashmap_entry with a given hash code, setting next to NULL.

methods.name: hashmap_get_size
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the hashmap if counting is enabled.

methods.name: hashmap_get
methods.description: Retrieves a hashmap entry matching a given key and key data.

methods.name: hashmap_get_from_hash
methods.description: Retrieves a hashmap entry based on a precomputed hash and key data.

methods.name: hashmap_get_next
methods.description: Returns the next hashmap entry equal to a given entry, for iteration.

methods.name: hashmap_add
methods.description: Adds a new entry to the hashmap, allowing duplicates.

methods.name: hashmap_put
methods.description: Adds or replaces an entry in the hashmap.

methods.name: hashmap_remove
methods.description: Removes an entry matching the key and key data from the hashmap.

methods.name: hashmap_bucket
methods.description: Returns the bucket index where an entry with a given hash is stored.

methods.name: hashmap_iter_init
methods.description: Initializes an iterator for traversing the hashmap.

methods.name: hashmap_iter_next
methods.description: Returns the next entry in the hashmap during iteration.

methods.name: hashmap_iter_first
methods.description: Initializes the iterator and returns the first entry.

methods.name: hashmap_iter_first_entry
methods.description: Returns the first entry of a specific type in the hashmap using the iterator.

methods.name: hashmap_for_each_entry
methods.description: Macro to iterate over all entries in the hashmap.

methods.name: hashmap_get_entry
methods.description: Macro to retrieve a specific entry by key.

methods.name: hashmap_get_entry_from_hash
methods.description: Macro to retrieve an entry using a precomputed hash.

methods.name: hashmap_get_next_entry
methods.description: Macro to get the next entry equal to a given entry.

methods.name: hashmap_for_each_entry_from
methods.description: Macro to iterate over entries starting from a specific entry.

methods.name: hashmap_disable_item_counting
methods.description: Disables automatic item counting and rehashing.

methods.name: hashmap_enable_item_counting
methods.description: Re-enables item counting and updates the count.

methods.name: memintern
methods.description: Returns a unique interned version of the given data, stored in a global pool.

methods.name: strintern
methods.description: Returns an interned string version of the input string.
